description: Read one published National Digital page as clean Markdown, given an id from search (the page's site path, e.g. /platform-engineering/) or its full URL. Returns the page's text with its title, canonical url and last-modified date. Long pages are returned in parts; pass the returned nextOffset as offset to read the next part.

id.description: A page id from search (its site path, e.g. /about/) or the page URL.

offset.description: Character offset to read from; pass nextOffset from the previous part.

name: fetch
title: Read a National Digital page
